opportunity: The two thresholds ActionMarkExplicit uses to decide whether a computed value gets its own declared local or is inlined at every use (Architecture::max_implied_ref and max_term_duplication) were compiled-in constants, both 2, with no command reaching either. Upstream's own comments next to them read '2 is best, in specific cases a higher number might be good' and '2 and 3 (4) are reasonable' -- values it expects to be tried. Exposing them turns a rebuild into a per-run flag, and gives the variable-count lane its ablation lever.
test_name: tests/stages/kuna-impliedrefs.xml (6 assertions, two synthetic gcc -O2 functions, four passes) + 3 unit tests in p6_variables/kuna_impliedrefs.rs
inspiration: Ghidra's own comments on max_implied_ref / max_term_duplication in Architecture::resetDefaultsInternal
root_cause: Not a defect: the constants were simply never surfaced. The reading sites (base_explicit, process_multiplier) already took both off the per-function ArchSeam context, which Architecture refreshes from these fields at every function, so the options write the fields and the pass is untouched.
coupling: max_implied_ref is a program-wide tunable, not private to explicit-marking: Funcdata::bb_is_complex (upstream BlockBasic::isComplex, the OR-clause absorb test of CollapseStructure::rule_block_or) and p8_structure/kuna_condfold.rs bound a condition block's printed statements with the same field, so `impliedrefs` loosens those two structure tests along with the marking. Stated in the catalog row and docs/spec/06-variables-and-merge.md rather than split into a second field.

ablation.method: kuna decompile-all <bin> --option <name> <value>, declared locals counted out of the emitted C (a declaration-block line naming a vN local); functions_changed is per-function text inequality against the default dump
ablation.note: impliedrefs 6 declaring MORE than impliedrefs 4 is real, not noise: letting a wider value stay implied inflates its Cover, which changes what the speculative merges can combine, so the declaration count is not monotone in the bound.

hunk_classification_impliedrefs_4.kind: every changed function is declaration-removal plus local renumbering; no statement is re-anchored across a control-flow boundary and no call site is gained or lost

witness.why: v6 has exactly three readers, one over the shipped bound of 2

default_identity.self_check: kuna decompile-all fmt with no options == --option impliedrefs 2 == --option termdup 2, byte for byte

cross_binary.corpus: 20 decbench stripped ELFs (12 O2: coreutils od/libstdbuf.so/nproc/expr/getlimits, bzip2, chibios ch.elf, sysvinit halt/killall5, shadow groupmod/login/chfn; 8 O0: diffutils sdiff, chibios ch.elf, dpkg dpkg-divert/dpkg-statoverride, coreutils [ /cat/chgrp, e2fsprogs e2fsck)
cross_binary.arms: this branch's kuna vs the main build, both `decompile-all` at shipped defaults
